claims.value: Probably entered the Ambrosiana with the Galeazzo Arconati donation of 1637
claims.statement: A search summary of Ambrosiana material says the panel probably came with Count Galeazzo Arconati's 1637 donation (with the Codex Atlanticus), and links it to Federico Borromeo's description of a 'portrait of a Duchess of Milan' by Leonardo. Both are reconstructions and conflict with other accounts that place it in Borromeo's 1618 foundation gift.

background.text: The Portrait of a Musician is an unfinished painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Leonardo da Vinci, dated to c. 1483, 1487. Produced while Leonardo was in Milan, the work is painted in oils, and perhaps tempera, on a small panel of walnut wood. It is his only known male portrait painting, and the identity of its sitter has been closely debated among scholars.
Il Ritratto di musico è un dipinto a olio su tavola di Leonardo da Vinci, databile al 1485 circa e conservato nella Pinacoteca Ambrosiana di Milano.

Le Portrait de musicien, généralement considéré comme le « portrait d'Atalante Migliorotti levant la tête » décrit par Léonard dans son inventaire, est un tableau de Léonard de Vinci peint vers l'an 1485 à l’huile sur du bois. Il est exposé à la Pinacothèque Ambrosienne de Milan.
